BEHIND THE BLOCK / CREDITS

MADE FOR THE CITY.

Grand Theft Block Party is an original playable crime story set in Harrow City. Every street, character, mission, and soundscape is created for this demo.

SOURCE INFORMATION

Inspired by Grand Theft Auto 4 for Xbox 360, PS3 and PC. Built with my-3d2dge and browser-native JavaScript, WebGL, and Web Audio. Art direction: cinematic rain, blue-hour streets, amber neon, and a city with a long memory.

ENGINE FEEDBACK

The game's built-in settings and controller input use my-3d2dge. The city soundscape and interface are authored specifically for Harrow City.
